description: This file defines the GeoPointFieldDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of GeoPointField content fields within OrchardCore CMS. It includes methods for rendering display and edit shapes, and handling updates with validation.

classes.name: GeoPointFieldDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for GeoPointField, handling display, editing, and updating of geographic point data within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Generates the display shape for a GeoPointField, supporting detail and summary views.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Creates the edit shape for a GeoPointField, initializing model properties with current field values.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the update process for a GeoPointField, validating input and updating the field accordingly.
